hero.title: The Future of Microbial Analysis
hero.subtitle: Replace subjective manual counting with deterministic AI precision. PlateSense delivers immutable, audit-ready microbiological data in milliseconds, not hours.

features.title: Intelligent Microbiology Platform
features.subtitle: PlateSense combines high-precision AI counting with interactive laboratory simulation, delivering a complete ecosystem for modern microbiological analysis.
features.accuracy_desc: Our proprietary vision models are trained on millions of annotated plates, detecting subtle morphologies that escape the human eye.
features.speed_desc: Transform a tedious manual process into a real-time data stream. What takes an analyst hours to count and document is processed instantly.
features.battle_mode_desc: Sharpen your skills with our Battle Mode simulator. Compete against the AI in real-time colony counting to validate your expertise and improve accuracy.
features.human_loop_desc: Flagged anomalous plates are automatically routed to senior microbiologists for final review before archival.
features.explainable_desc: Visual heatmaps overlay every scan, demonstrating exactly which morphological features triggered the classification.

workflow.title: Precision Workflow
workflow.subtitle: Streamlined microbiological analysis in three simple steps.
workflow.step1_desc: Define media parameters and upload high-resolution petri dish imagery to the secure analysis cloud.
workflow.step2_desc: State-of-the-art vision models detect, count, and classify colonies with sub-millisecond precision.
workflow.step3_desc: Review explainable AI results, manually validate anomalies, and generate immutable analytical reports.

overview.title: Overview
overview.desc: PlateSense utilizes state-of-the-art computer vision to automate the counting of bacterial colonies. This workflow is divided into three distinct stages designed to ensure scientific accuracy and auditability.

setup.title: Configuration & Parameters
setup.tsa_desc: General-purpose media supporting a wide range of aerobic bacteria and fungi.
setup.macconkey_desc: Selective and differential media used to isolate Gram-negative enteric bacteria.
setup.blood_desc: Enriched media used to grow fastidious organisms and detect hemolytic activity.
setup.sda_desc: Selective for fungi (yeasts and molds) due to its low pH and high glucose concentration.
setup.volume_desc: The exact amount of liquid sample spread on the agar surface. Standard protocols use 0.1 mL for spread plates or 1.0 mL for pour plates.
setup.dilution_desc: The negative exponent of your serial dilution. -4 represents a 1:10,000 dilution, used to backtrack to the original sample density.

ai.title: AI Inference Engine
ai.desc: Our latest YOLOv11-based model scans every pixel for bacterial clusters with extreme precision. It provides a Confidence Score to ensure data integrity—if the score is below threshold, manual review is recommended.

verification.title: Verification & Archiving
verification.desc: Once the AI finishes, you have the final say. You can manually adjust counts if needed before finalizing. Once finalized, a professional PDF report is generated, and the data is archived in your history for long-term tracking.
